name: Moody Night 3D
description: Night-cinema 3D style: a dusk-blue sky fill with one warm accent key, drifting fog, deep contrast, satin materials and a low cinematic camera that rises, glides and drifts hand-held. A style only: the agent builds the world and every subject from scratch for each video. No emoji.
prompt_hint: 6-10 scenes (3-5 s). Each: title.kicker + title.main, visual.type "scene3d" with a `world` (concept, ground, backdrop, parts) and `custom` objects built from scratch for THIS video; no stock set, character or car. Use fx (dust, embers, glow, spotlight), camera moves and `shots` for the cinematic feel. No emoji.
